title: Good News For Us
author: KedericTheOgre
selftext:
I am a game dev hobbyist, not full time. In the business world, I am seeing a flurry of hiring for AI roles and (surprisingly) getting some good opportunities and interviews. 

Companies know AI is out there, many have failed to implement it effectively, and they are looking for people who have actually *built* something.

I got asked “What have you done on the side to learn and grow?” It is awesome to see their eyes light up when I tell them I vibe coded a game and learned so much about design, user experience, AI functionality, systems thinking.

My friends, now is our time!

comments.author: oadephon
comments.body: That's awesome! What kind of positions are you applying for? Software stuff, or other business roles?

replies.author: KedericTheOgre
replies.body: Mostly AI Enablement, AI Adoption, or even AI director roles. There is a lot of interest in you teaching people to use AI effectively beyond just drafting emails. There are so many translatable skills between game dev and business applications, and honestly, if you gamify work everyone wins
